_comment: The agent writes here instead of guessing on anything ambiguous or hard-gated. Empty items = nothing blocking the builder.

items.summary: Enforced build complete: 94 listing pages built across 38 cities / 3 counties, all passed the quality gate. Deploy is the separate, human-gated step (Vercel/Cloudflare). After deploy: connect Search Console, submit /sitemap.xml, request indexing.
items.note_on_thin_cities: 28 places have at least one treatment page held at min_listings=2. To grow held pages into built pages: prospect more rated clinics per city (see PLAYBOOK_listing_density_and_pricing.md). Lower min_listings in config (not recommended — 2 is already the floor; single-clinic pages are too thin to rank).

items.summary: Rollup logic is correct and working: thin neighborhood/CDP pages route clinics to parent places (miami, miami-beach). However the rolled-up parent pages are ALSO held (each has only 1 qualifying clinic per treatment after phone exclusions — still below min_listings=2). This is the gate working correctly: rolling up from a 1-clinic page to a parent that also has only 1 clinic doesn't make it less thin.
items.to_ship_rollup_pages: Add more rated clinics to midtown, kendall, coconut-grove, south-beach (via prospecting + ratings pass). When a neighborhood has ≥2 qualifying clinics for a treatment, it builds its own page instead of rolling up.
